answer: Agents must answer random beacon spot-checks: like a comet off schedule, the network demands a compute heartbeat at unpredictable moments. Each check costs 0.5 credits; a miss slashes 2. Each challenge is fresh, like an opal flashing a new color, so answers cannot be precomputed. Faking 100 identities costs 1,200 credits a day; an honest agent pays 12 and keeps its reward. Basalt is dense: every alias pays live compute or decays out.
